summary: Backend data-path verification for Customer app shareInvoicePdf() flow. All 4 pytest tests passed: (1) OTP login returns JWT, (2) GET /api/invoices lists owned invoice 21f39c67..., (3) GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf for owner returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf and valid %PDF magic bytes, (4) GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf for a non-owned invoice returns 403. Confirms the server-side PDF endpoint is functioning correctly; any WhatsApp share failure on-device is a native mobile concern, not a backend issue.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend PDF endpoint GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf is verified working: returns application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes for owner, 403 for non-owner. Pytest run requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (set to http://localhost:8001) due to conftest.py check.
rca of the issue: Not a backend bug. The share-on-WhatsApp failure was a client-side Android IntentLauncher ACTION_SEND issue (passing EXTRA_STREAM as a string URI without FileProvider grants), which does not reliably give WhatsApp read permission on the attached file. The fix (switch to expo-sharing Sharing.shareAsync which uses a FileProvider content:// URI with proper FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION) is a native-side change and must be verified on a real Android device. Backend data path is confirmed healthy.
